source: Fitted Oct 8, 2026 in the land-cover spike (exp25c and exp25d on the project's server) on 277 isolated, compact, single-topped shrub clumps from the ten test areas' central 500 m: Theil-Sen on log width against log height, with the spread 1.4826 x the median absolute deviation of log width. Width is the clump's equal-area width; bush: mostly near-infrared green, sage: not green, a plant by its lidar scatter. docs/19 §19.8.

dome.note: the shape the score rebuilds each shrub with: z = H * (1 - a * (d/R)^n)
